jobs.title: Sales Director
jobs.descriptionHtml:
What we are building at Soylent

Soylent makes meal-planning software for hospital and university kitchens. Catering teams use it to plan menus, order stock and cut food waste across every site they run.

Why it matters

Large kitchens still plan on spreadsheets and phone calls. Orders arrive late, stock runs out and good food is thrown away. Our customers plan a week of menus in an hour.

The team you will join

You will join a small sales team that sells to catering directors and procurement leads.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer, Revenue Engine
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hey! We're Soylent.ai

Soylent is a young company in an active growth period. We started this year as a small team and are hiring across product, engineering and sales.

Our team sits within Engineering and builds the tools our sales and customer success teams use every day. You will work directly with Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.
